person_note: The decisive Goodreads evidence is the sustained close-third narration in q00672 and especially q00674, with q00665 corroborating. First-person forms in q00664, q00666, and q00667 are local dialogue, not narrator speech; clipped or isolated third-person fragments were not allowed to vote mechanically. The authorized opening translation independently shows sustained third-person narration across several characters, while the whole-book point-of-view guide explicitly calls the novel third-person omniscient and the contemporary review corroborates its choral, mind-entering narrator. No evidence supports sustained narration in another person. The main limitation is that the Tier A excerpt is an opening in translation, but the interior quote evidence and whole-book descriptions resolve that scope limitation.
